lessons.title: 1. Relational Operators
lessons.description: Python provides comparison operators: `==` (equal), `!=` (not equal), `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`. Write `is_equal(a, b)` and `is_greater(a, b)`.

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Comparisons — Expressions (Language Reference) — Expressions

exercises.question: Match each comparison operator to the question it asks.

pairs.right: do the two values hold the same content?
is a strictly larger than b?
is a no more than b?

correct_answer.a == b: do the two values hold the same content?
correct_answer.a > b: is a strictly larger than b?
correct_answer.a <= b: is a no more than b?

exercises.explanation: `==` and `=` are not the same thing: one compares, the other assigns.

lessons.title: 2. Chained Comparisons
lessons.description: Python allows chaining comparisons like `min_val <= x <= max_val`. Write `in_range(x, low, high)`.
lessons.solution_code:
def in_range(x, low, high):
    return low <= x <= high

lessons.title: 4. Rollercoaster Entry Check (Practice)
lessons.description: Determine if a person can ride a rollercoaster: `age >= 10` and `height_cm >= 130`.
lessons.solution_code:
def can_ride(age, height_cm):
    return age >= 10 and height_cm >= 130
